We are completely full and we need your help.

Last week, we took in nearly 100 animals. Since then, adoptions have been incredibly slow, leaving our kennels overflowing and dogs waiting longer than they should.

We have Labs, Shepherds, puppies, and so many other deserving dogs who didn\u2019t come in with this recent group but are still waiting, as well. Right now, they need people to show up for them.

If you\u2019ve been thinking about adopting, please come in  to our shelter. We truly have a match for everyone.
